remarks: This is YOUR opportunity to build the home of your dreams that you have yet to find or have yet to win that bid on! Welcome to 120 Briscoe Road, a 2 acre buildable lot right around the corner from St Luke's School and an 8 min drive to desirable downtown New Canaan with it's amazing restaurants and shops. Current lot has a ranch home and a log cabin on site. Restore or Tear down. There is a Generous, flat, buildable square-once you ascend up the driveway off of Briscoe Road. Utilities are well water and septic. Oil tank was removed successfully and lot is clean and ready for the next custom home! This 2 acre lot follows 2 acre zoning regulations but is surrounded by 4 acre properties that allow for nice elbow room, privacy and coverage. This is a wonderful prospect for all end users and builders! Please have confirmed appointment to walk land with listing agent. Easy to show!
